review.notes: Source-backed sheet replacements and progression. External prerequisites, optional replacements, companions, complex combat effects and extra named subchoices manual.

features.name: Cyberpunked
features.description:
Starting at 1st level, a cyberpunk warrior begins play with a cybernetic arm. A cyberpunk warrior gains a slam attack for each cybernetic arm. These attacks deal 1d6 points of bludgeoning damage for a Medium cyberpunk warrior and 1d4 points of bludgeoning damage for a Small cyberpunk warrior. At 5th level and every four warrior levels thereafter, the cyberpunk warrior gains cybernetic arm enhancers. The cybernetic arm does not count towards his max limit of implantation points.

This ability replaces martial flexibility.
Sheet support: conditional combat bonuses, temporary forms, equipment, prerequisites and any extra subchoices are applied manually using existing sheet entries.

features.name: Artificial Resilience
features.description:
At 4th level, a cyberpunk warrior fortifies his body against organic weaknesses. He receives a +4 bonus on all saving throws against paralysis, poison, and stun effects, and becomes immune to fatigue, exhaustion, disease, and sleep effects. In addition, the cyberpunk warrior can be healed through effects that repair objects or constructs.

This ability replaces physical resilience and aggressor.
Sheet support: conditional combat bonuses, temporary forms, equipment, prerequisites and any extra subchoices are applied manually using existing sheet entries.

features.name: Cybernetic Combat
features.description:
At 6th level, a cyberpunk warrior gains a +1 bonus on attack rolls and damage rolls with implanted weapons, cybernetic arms, and melee or thrown weapons wielded with a cybernetic arm. Weapons wielded with two cybernetic arms receive double the bonus, except when such weapons are thrown. This bonus increases by 1 for every four warrior levels gained after 6th.

This ability replaces robust physique.
Sheet support: conditional combat bonuses, temporary forms, equipment, prerequisites and any extra subchoices are applied manually using existing sheet entries.

features.name: Improved Implantation
features.description:
At 7th level, a cyberpunk warrior can exceed the normal limitations on cybertech implantation. His brain and body slots each accommodate one more piece of cybertech than normal. In addition, his limit on implantation points increases by half his warrior level. He can allocate these points between his Intelligence and Constitution scores as he chooses. At 15th level, his body slot can accommodate two more pieces of cybertech than normal.

This ability replaces additional techs III and combat composure.

features.name: Improved Artificial Resilience
features.description:
At 10th level, the cyberpunk warrior’s body becomes even more refined. He becomes immune to [paralysis](https://www.d20pfsrd.com/gamemastering/special-abilities#TOC-Paralysis), [poison](https://www.d20pfsrd.com/gamemastering/afflictions#TOC-Poison), and [stun](https://www.d20pfsrd.com/gamemastering/conditions#TOC-Stunned) effects, and gains a +4 bonus on [saving throws](https://www.d20pfsrd.com/gamemastering/combat#TOC-Saving-Throws) against [mind-affecting](https://www.d20pfsrd.com/basics-ability-scores/glossary#TOC-Mind-Affecting) effects, death effects, [necromancy](https://www.d20pfsrd.com/magic#TOC-Necromancy) effects, [ability damage](https://www.d20pfsrd.com/basics-ability-scores/ability-scores#TOC-Ability-Score-Damage), [ability drain](https://www.d20pfsrd.com/basics-ability-scores/ability-scores#TOC-Ability-Drain), and [energy drain](https://www.d20pfsrd.com/gamemastering/special-abilities#TOC-Energy-Drain-and-Negative-Levels) effects. In addition, the cyberpunk warrior no longer needs to eat, [*sleep*](https://www.d20pfsrd.com/magic/all-spells/s/sleep), or breath.

This ability replaces war cry and unstoppable strike.
Sheet support: conditional combat bonuses, temporary forms, equipment, prerequisites and any extra subchoices are applied manually using existing sheet entries.

features.name: Resilience
features.description:
At 19th level, a cyberpunk warrior has a reservoir of 5 temporary hit points for each piece of implanted cybertech in his body. Lost temporary hit points are recovered at the rate of 10 points per hour.

This ability replaces assured strike.
Sheet support: conditional combat bonuses, temporary forms, equipment, prerequisites and any extra subchoices are applied manually using existing sheet entries.

features.name: Perfect Body
features.description:
At 20th level, the cyberpunk warrior has completed his masterful fusion of flesh and machinery. There is no longer a limit to how much cybertech a cyberpunk warrior can have stored on his body at any given time. In addition, the cyberpunk warrior gains [immunity](https://www.d20pfsrd.com/bestiary/rules-for-monsters/universal-monster-rules#TOC-Immunity-Ex-or-Su-) to death effects, [necromancy](https://www.d20pfsrd.com/magic#TOC-Necromancy) effects, [ability damage](https://www.d20pfsrd.com/basics-ability-scores/ability-scores#TOC-Ability-Score-Damage), [ability drain](https://www.d20pfsrd.com/basics-ability-scores/ability-scores#TOC-Ability-Drain), [energy drain](https://www.d20pfsrd.com/gamemastering/special-abilities#TOC-Energy-Drain-and-Negative-Levels), [bleed](https://www.d20pfsrd.com/gamemastering/conditions#TOC-Bleed), [nonlethal damage](https://www.d20pfsrd.com/gamemastering/combat#TOC-Nonlethal-Damage), and death from massive damage. Finally, the cyberpunk warrior no longer ages.

This ability replaces weapon mastery.
Sheet support: conditional combat bonuses, temporary forms, equipment, prerequisites and any extra subchoices are applied manually using existing sheet entries.
